text: Find same colours pairs until all are found. there is one that does not have a pair given that their are 9. And if you get it wrong flash red once. flash green when all pairs are found.

Got it! I'll make a matching game: tap two lights to peek at their colors, keep pairs that match, and get a red blink if they don't. One color is the lonely odd one out. When all four pairs are found, the whole board flashes green and a new round starts!
